children: Ukraine's central bank raised its key rate by half a point to 16% on Thursday, delivering a rare consecutive hike as inflationary pressures persisted amid intensified Russian air attacks and growing wartime uncertainty, officials said.

The central bank said in a statement that inflationary pressures remained high due to the consequences of the war with   Russia and the conflict in the Middle East. Ukraine's consumer inflation quickened to 8.1% year-on-year in August.
